origin.name: hao-runtime's x86_64 dyld (payload replace/dyld: 26B131's dyld with the libignition stage count fixed)
origin.note: written after hao-runtime installs it (set order); the arm64e slices are not touched

edits.mask: FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF 00 00 00 00 FF FF FF FF FF FF FF

asm.after: xor eax,eax; nop dword [rax]; test eax,eax; sete al

edits.reason: dyld honours on-disk roots of shared-cache images (OCLP's Metal wrapper and MetalOld) only on an internal install. This makes dyld alone count as one, so the ic_csr_internal boot-arg, which made every process see an Apple-internal build (mobileassetd then used Apple's internal asset server: no Spotlight, Siri or language assets), is no longer needed
edits.evidence: hao-opencore r52 refuses an image whose dyld lacks this edit; tests/test_edits.py proves the script and this spec write the same bytes on the hao_runtime row's dyld
